lines.text: The tribe of Levi has no inheritance, so priests eat the food offerings and receive the shoulder, jowls, and stomach.
A Levite who comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose serves there and eats equal portions.
Israel must not imitate nations that sacrifice children in the fire or consult mediums, for the LORD drives them out.
Moses says the LORD will raise up a prophet like him, and the people asked for this at Sinai.
If a prophet's message in the LORD's name fails, he spoke presumptuously; a prophet for other gods is exiled.
